concepts.label: Data Service reconfiguration (via remove-and-add)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the specific, named pattern for changing the Data Service on an existing node: since kv cannot be dynamically added/removed on a live node (unlike every other service), the only documented route is a full node-removal followed by a full node-addition of the same physical node with the Data Service toggled. A distinct, page-titled procedure, not simply a restatement of remove+add.

relations.subject: service:data-service
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - promoted predicate; captures that the Data Service specifically lacks the dynamic add/remove path every other service has
relations.evidence: Unlike other services, you cannot dynamically add or remove the Data Service on an existing node of a cluster.

relations.subject: server:data-service-reconfiguration
relations.evidence: To add the Data Service on an existing node of a cluster: 1. Remove the node that you want to add the Data Service to using [Remove a Node and Rebalance](remove-node-and-rebalance.md).

relations.subject: server:data-service-reconfiguration
relations.evidence: Then [add the node](#manage:manage-nodes/add-node-and-rebalance.html) back to the cluster after enabling the Data Service.

relations.subject: server:rebalance
relations.evidence: To complete the process of adding or removing a node, the rebalance operation must be run.

relations.subject: server/8.0/manage/manage-nodes/manage-data-service-and-rebalance
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused - structural markdown link on the page
relations.evidence: For more information about modifying non-Data Services on existing nodes, see [Modify Services and Rebalance](modify-services-and-rebalance.md).

notable_absence.finding: The page's own note warns that other services co-resident on a node being removed for Data-Service reconfiguration purposes may need to be temporarily relocated first ('you may need to add those services to another node temporarily') - a real operational constraint of this pattern that has no clean target concept to attach to in the current registry (it is about co-located services in general, not any one named service), so it is recorded here as text rather than forced into a relation.

cross_component_finding: This page is the sharpest confirmation in the batch that 'rebalance' fractures at the TRIGGER level, not at the rebalance-mechanism level: it explicitly titles itself as covering the Data Service specifically BECAUSE the Data Service is the one service that cannot go through the same dynamic add/remove path documented on modify-services-and-rebalance.json for every other service (index/n1ql/fts/cbas/eventing/backup). The page's only route for a live Data-Service change is to fall all the way back to the generic node-removal/node-addition procedures - i.e. the SAME rebalance-triggering primitives already used for whole-node topology changes, repurposed here for a single-service change. This directly answers this round's central question for the Data Service specifically: there is no 'data-service-specific rebalance' as a distinct mechanism; there is only the ABSENCE of a dynamic path other services have, forcing reuse of the node-level one.
